rules.name: xoga747-05-pipeline-configs-dev-vs-uat
rules.sql: SELECT template_name, md5(rule_data::text) AS rule_md5, rule_data #>> '{workflowConfig,workflowId}' AS workflow_id, rule_data #>> '{workflowConfig,output,mode}' AS output_mode, jsonb_array_length(coalesce(rule_data #> '{workflowConfig,additionalOutputs}', '[]'::jsonb)) AS additional_outputs, jsonb_array_length(coalesce(rule_data #> '{workflowConfig,output,options,extraSheets}', '[]'::jsonb)) AS extra_sheets, rule_data #>> '{workflowConfig,output,options,intermediateSheetsFirst}' AS intermediate_first, rule_data #>> '{workflowConfig,output,options,embedIntermediateSheets}' AS embed_flag, rule_data #>> '{workflowConfig,messageExport,enabled}' AS message_export, updated_by, left(updated_timestamp::text, 19) AS updated_at FROM opera.oga_configservice_uploadrules WHERE code = 'PIPELINE CONFIG' AND tenant_id = :tenant

SELECT template_name, md5(rule_data::text) AS rule_md5, rule_data #>> '{workflowConfig,workflowId}' AS workflow_id, rule_data #>> '{workflowConfig,output,mode}' AS output_mode, jsonb_array_length(coalesce(rule_data #> '{workflowConfig,additionalOutputs}', '[]'::jsonb)) AS additional_outputs, jsonb_array_length(coalesce(rule_data #> '{workflowConfig,output,options,extraSheets}', '[]'::jsonb)) AS extra_sheets, rule_data #>> '{workflowConfig,output,options,intermediateSheetsFirst}' AS intermediate_first, rule_data #>> '{workflowConfig,output,options,embedIntermediateSheets}' AS embed_flag, rule_data #>> '{workflowConfig,messageExport,enabled}' AS message_export, updated_by, left(updated_timestamp::text, 19) AS updated_at FROM opera.oga_configservice_uploadrules WHERE code = 'PIPELINE CONFIG' AND tenant_id = :tenant

expect.reason: dev and UAT carry the same pipeline configs
